This is the exact class of cross-layer contradiction the review brief instructs to report (layer specs as normative refinements of design.md): design.md/requirements.md's reconciled 'Stream C status record' (ADR-0010 Accepted commit 67015a5, T-004 landed tests/workflow-scenarios/ and workflow-scenarios.tests.sh, acceptance-tests.md AC-014/TEST-014 now 'Planned' per the QG-remediation reconciliation note) was not propagated into security-spec.md, so a reader relying on the designated canonical security-detail document would wrongly conclude AC-014's inbound-prompt-injection control is unimplemented/unverified and that writing to tests/workflow-scenarios/ is still denied -- undermining confidence in whether this security boundary's verification has actually occurred.
